speaker: john_harrison
text: Master Shakespeare. You are between a rehearsal and a dinner, by the ink on the hand. I have a thing from the Hall, and I shall tell it as I tell a sale, which is to say of a third party.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tell it so. Navarre is at two. What did the Hall do this morning?

speaker: john_harrison
text: Cuthbert Burby entered a book. A play of King Edward the Third, that has been played about the City. I am told there are scenes in it of a king and a countess that are thought to be in your manner, Master Shakespeare.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They are thought so because they are. I made them three years gone, or four, for another company, for a fee. I have not thought of them since, except one line.

speaker: john_harrison
text: I am not asking whose manner. I am telling you whose entry. The manner is how a stall learns what to lay in the window.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Of the man who made the scenes. Of the company that played them. Of anyone who might still be using a line of it.

speaker: john_harrison
text: Sixpence to the Hall, Master Shakespeare, buys a title its place in the book. It does not buy the author's afternoon, and it does not ask for one. A title must promise something quickly. What is made of the promise after, the buyer discovers when he has paid.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I thought that at a bill-post in October, and I let it pass for plays. A printed title is a harder post. It gathers a king and a countess into a window, and it leaves out the company, the hands, and the name.

speaker: john_harrison
text: No name is sometimes a kindness and sometimes a loss. I do not decide which, before your dinner. I have written the morning in the day-book as a report. It is not the register. Look, if you want the words I had, and not the words the City will make by Thursday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will look. There will not be a claim from me today. I remember one line for certain. Lilies that fester. If the scenes are the scenes, the line is in his entered book, and it is in a thing that lies in my folder at home.

speaker: john_harrison
text: Then the Hall has the paper, and you have the making, and sixpence has done all a sixpence can. I tell third parties third-party news. It is how a bookseller stays friends with a Hall.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sixpence. And the line. If a man asks you whether the countess is mine, tell him you were told the scenes were in my manner. That is true. It is less than the making.

speaker: john_harrison
text: Good day, Master Shakespeare. Eat. A title is a poor dinner.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good day. I shall get the sixpence and the line in the wrong order all the way up to Bishopsgate.
